title: Seeing the Options: Typed Decisions over Visual Candidates with Reusable Option Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.33702v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Typed decision-making tasks in agents, such as UI element selection, product recommendation, and chart matching, require models to choose from a set of discrete candidates. While prior work demonstrates that text-only System One models achieve four key properties including candidate-order invariance, scalability, and cache reuse via separate request-candidate encoding, extending them to multimodal settings where candidates are visual remains underexplored. We introduce Iris, a framework that accommodates image, text, or hybrid candidates while preserving the core decision module. We prove that order invariance and exact cache reuse hold for any per-candidate encoder under Iris, and derive the closed-form latency reduction. We construct a visual-candidate benchmark from Multimodal-Mind2Web (K=16, deduplicated, order-shuffled, three generalization splits). Independent encoding (Iris) achieves 78.4 / 72.1 / 74.8 percent accuracy with zero-f

translated_title: 看见选项：基于可复用选项记忆的视觉候选类型化决策
translated_abstract: 智能体中的类型化决策任务，例如UI元素选择、产品推荐和图表匹配，要求模型从一组离散候选中进行选择。尽管先前的工作表明，纯文本的System One模型通过分离的请求-候选编码实现了候选顺序不变性、可扩展性和缓存复用等四个关键属性，但将其扩展到候选为视觉内容的多模态设置仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了Iris，一个能够容纳图像、文本或混合候选同时保留核心决策模块的框架。我们证明了在Iris下，顺序不变性和精确缓存复用对任何逐候选编码器都成立，并推导出延迟降低的闭式表达式。我们基于Multimodal-Mind2Web构建了一个视觉候选基准（K=16、去重、顺序打乱、三个泛化划分）。独立编码（Iris）实现了78.4 / 72.1 / 74.8的准确率，且零……
tldr: 提出Iris框架，将支持顺序不变性与精确缓存复用的类型化决策扩展到视觉、文本或混合候选场景，并证明了该性质对任意逐候选编码器均成立。
en_tdlr: Iris extends typed decision-making with order invariance and exact cache reuse to visual, text, or hybrid candidates, proving these properties hold for any per-candidate encoder.
